notes.text: Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.
Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Roman needed hands-on help getting out of the tub today and said he has been skipping showers because he is afraid of slipping.
Roman enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.

ADL reassessment. Roman now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; independent at last review. Recommend tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and increasing home care hours for bathing support.
Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.
Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.

Roman reported a fall at home on Oct 19, 2026 in the kitchen while reaching for a cabinet. His niece Linda found him on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. Small skin tear to left forearm, cleaned and dressed. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Oct 19, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.

Linda reports Roman has been more confused in the evenings for about two weeks, once leaving the stove on. Oriented to person and place today but not date. No fever. Plan: urinalysis, medication review, and PCP visit this week.
Roman attended day center, joined chair exercise and music group, and ate most of lunch.

Weight 75.2 kg, down from 82.3 kg on Sep 5, 2026 (9%). Roman reports poor appetite and skipping breakfast. Eating about 50% of day center lunches. Plan: oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and dental check for chewing problems.
